title: Standard CDC from Lakebase refused the publication it needs (fixed)
symptom: The gateway setup fails on the publication
cause: Lakebase doesn't allow the publication standard CDC creates
effect: Standard CDC from Lakebase doesn't run
fix: Lakebase now allows CREATE PUBLICATION for a non-superuser role. Standard CDC ran end to end on 2026-11-01 on AWS (serverless gateway): source type POSTGRESQL, a password role with REPLICATION, and the project's password connections turned on (Settings > Database connections; new projects have them off)
